title: Discover the FREE Art Gallery Inside Los Angeles City Hall
description:
Discover a hidden art gallery inside Los Angeles City Hall! The Henry P. Rio Bridge Gallery, known as the “People’s Gallery,” is a rotating exhibition space that celebrates the diverse cultures, histories, and communities that shape Los Angeles.

Managed by the City of Los Angeles Department of Cultural Affairs, the gallery features rotating exhibitions throughout the year, highlighting Latino, African American, Native American, LGBTQIA+, and other cultural perspectives through art.

The exhibition featured in the video is "Corazón de Los Ángeles: The Art of Chicano Politics & Community Healing," presented by AltaMed Health Services. The exhibition showcases historic and contemporary artwork that honors cultural roots, community identity, and artistic expression.

Free and open to the public during City Hall’s public access hours, the Henry P. Rio Bridge Gallery invites Angelenos to explore its ever-changing exhibitions and discover the art and stories that connect the people of Los Angeles.
